title.rendered: PUBG Mobile Lite 0.26.0 Apk Data Download

content.rendered:
Download PUBG Mobile Lite 0.26.0 Apk obb which works on major Android device smoothly without any server or game play issues such has control, recoil control is now easier than before. 

PUBG Mobile Lite For Android was developed for those who are having difficulties in installing the full version on there device, the lite version of PUBG Mobile offers same experience with full version. 

In the lite version 60 players have to compete by landing on Erangel compare to the full version where 100 players are needed to compete in Erangel and the last Squad, Duo or solo player to survive wins the match. 

The overall size of PUBG Mobile Lite is Just 500 MB, which will not consume much space in your device and it is very easy to install by just clicking on the apk app after download and wait till PUBG Lite is successfully installed.

Basic features available in the full version of PUBG Mobile are also available in PUBG Lite Mobile version.
